text: Gandhi spent Independence Day, not in Delhi, but in Calcutta, fasting to stop the killing.
Five months later, on 30 January 1948, he was shot dead in Delhi by a Hindu extremist.
And India still had another enormous problem.
More than 560 princely states, each ruled by its own Maharaja or Nawab, had to decide where to go.
The man in charge was the Home Minister, Sardar Vallabhay Patel, with his right-hand man, V.P. Menon.

Kashmir's rulers signed after raiders from Pakistan invaded and the first war

Then India wrote its rules.
A committee led by Dr. Ambitkar drafted the Constitution,
the longest written constitution of any country.
It came into force on the 26th of January,
1950, Republic Day. And it did something many which democracies took centuries to do.
It gave every adult the vote from
day one, rich or poor, man or woman, of every caste and religion. In the first election
in 1951, about 170 million people were eligible to vote. Most of them could not read, so
each party had a picture symbol. The biggest election the world had ever seen! Run on pictures!
